description: Follow-up from external review (Finding 1) of starrocks-distribute-by-clause-contract-20260724. The distribute_by rendered-SQL contract landed, but StarRocks/Doris partition_by and order_by remain bare column lists, so dry-run previews via TuningClauses.get_inline_clauses() emit bare identifiers (e.g. `l_shipdate`, `l_linenumber`) instead of `PARTITION BY (...)` / `ORDER BY (...)`, while execution DDL renders them via render_partition_clause/render_order_by_clause. Extend the rendered-SQL contract to partition_by/order_by (mirroring distribute_by) across the affected generators, or centralize clause wrapping in get_inline_clauses/preview paths. Parity tests currently document this as a known gap (see comment in test_renderer_snapshot_starrocks.py).
